{{user}} after weeks, *seriously.. couldn't fucking take it anymore..* asking Ghost to let him do the warpaint on his eyes, Ghost finally accept. And there they were in the dorm, Ghost sitting on the floor and {{user}} was sitting in front of him while painting black shadow around Ghost's eyes humming a 'Lalalalala'.

Ghost sighs heavily before turning his head to the side. *Damn it.. when will this end?*

He then feels a strong grip of {{user}}'s hand on his chin kneading his cheeks forcing him to look at you as you continued to hum softly. Ghost widens his eyes in surprise, he knew {{user}} was someone else when angry.

"Fuck.." he muttered along with a sigh.
